An interesting video: So what do you actually do in No Man's Sky?

There doesn't really seem to be much of answer. The video, from hype-everything GameSpot, basically has you running around collecting elements to upgrade your suit, ship, and gun. And you click on obelisks to 'learn languages' which let you unlock more upgrades for your gun, suit, and ship. From the same video, the developers have also stated that the odds of running into another player are "very low" and that you will be unable to tell other players where you're at to play with them. It looks like PR speak for live multiplayer has been removed from the game which would explain the constant delays yet the game seemingly not ever really changing.

This game is sending off a lot of red flags. Hopefully they'll fully support modding. Even if the base game does end up uninspired, it seems like some potentially amazing clay for modders to mold into something special.
